items.title: A morphism of formal spectra is smooth exactly when the corresponding ring is a power series ring

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a ring map R -> S in the completed category the induced morphism of formal spectra is smooth exactly when S is a power series ring over R (statement lines 2241-2247). The proof (proof lines 2249-2319) translates smoothness into a lifting property, constructs in the nontrivial direction a surjective map onto the power series ring together with a section and compares relative cotangent spaces, and in the other direction builds the dotted arrow from lifts of the images of the variables. H3: two independent directions with genuine constructions on both sides, written out in full.
